ogImage.description: Auto-generated Open Graph image (1200x630). Stored separately from coverImage so the cover can be human-curated while ogImage is regenerated from the latest thread state.

sortOrder.description: Display order of checkpoints by checkpointAt. 'desc' (default) shows newest first, 'asc' shows oldest first.

defaultView.description: Which view the thread detail opens in: 'timeline' (default when absent), 'log' (searchable list), or 'review' (stats). Display preference only; does not affect stored posts.

tagGroups.description: Deprecated: superseded by fields (select). Kept for records written before fields existed.

label.description: Group heading shown in the filter UI (e.g. 場所)

tags.description: Tags in this group, stored without the leading #

fields.description: Custom input fields for checkpoints in this thread. Values live in post.fields and reference field/option by id, so labels can be renamed freely.

tags.description: Tags classifying the thread itself (e.g. 旅行, オフ会), stored without the leading '#'. Not propagated to posts; used to filter threads on profile / dashboard.

defaultTags.description: Tags pre-filled on new checkpoints in this thread (the author can remove them per post). Stored without the leading '#'.

updatedAt.description: Last activity by the thread owner (checkpoint created/edited/deleted, thread edited). Used to order thread lists; falls back to createdAt when absent.

endedAt.description: Set when the owner marks the thread as finished. Ended threads default to ascending checkpoint order (read as a story) and stop accepting participant posts. Absent while ongoing.

id.description: Stable opaque id, unique within the thread. Never derived from label.

multiple.description: select only. true = checkboxes, false/absent = radio

scale.description: number only. Decimal digits accepted in the input UI (display hint)

archived.description: Hidden from the input UI; existing values still resolve

label.description: Shown in UI and used as the hashtag on cross-post (normalized by normalizeTag)
